complaint_text: Order mein paneer wrap aur fries dono mangaye the, but fries missing thi and wrap bhi cold tha. ₹189 ka item missing hai practically. App support bas bot chala raha hai, 3 baar chat kiya. Please refund the missing item, not just a coupon.
company_reply_email: Hi, we understand your concern and have noted your feedback. Your experience matters to us and our team is continuously working to improve delivery quality. We appreciate your patience and cooperation.
safest_next_action: Escalate to the platform's Grievance Officer and request a refund for the missing item with a complaint reference number.

complaint_text: Ordered 2 packs of baby diapers and a milk carton. One diaper pack wasn't delivered, but invoice and payment are for all 3 products. Delivery guy says packet was sealed so he can't help. Amount of missing pack is ₹499. Need refund, not store credits.
company_reply_email: We have forwarded your concern to our concerned team. A refund of ₹499 has been initiated from our end. Kindly allow some time for the amount to reflect in your account. We are unable to share a transaction reference at this moment.
safest_next_action: Ask for the refund transaction reference and a defined credit timeline before treating the complaint as resolved.

complaint_text: Received a different colour kurta than what was shown in listing. Listing was navy blue but received black. Return pickup happened 8 days ago and tracking says returned to seller, still refund is not done. ₹1,299 paid. This is getting ridiculous.
company_reply_email: Dear customer, we regret the inconvenience. We have processed your refund of ₹1,299 to the original payment method. The refund transaction reference is UTR 847261903518. Please check with your bank if the amount has not yet appeared in your account.
safest_next_action: Verify the refund against the provided UTR with your bank and reopen the grievance if the credit is missing.

complaint_text: Bought earbuds from your official website. Left side stopped working in 11 days. Service centre says replacement is possible but I need to pay inspection charges even though product is under warranty. Why should I pay? Order value ₹2,499.
company_reply_email: Dear customer, as per our service policy, inspection charges are applicable in certain cases. Our service team has reviewed the complaint and the product does not qualify for a free replacement under the current assessment. We regret that we cannot accommodate the request for free replacement at this stage.
safest_next_action: Escalate to the brand's Grievance Officer with the warranty terms, purchase invoice and inspection findings.

complaint_text: Flight ST 614 was cancelled 5 hours before departure. I was offered another flight next day but had to book another airline myself because I had a connection to catch. ₹6,800 for original ticket. I want a refund and compensation as applicable.
company_reply_email: Dear passenger, we acknowledge receipt of your feedback. Your concern has been registered with our customer care team and will be reviewed in accordance with our applicable policies. We will get back to you if further information is required.
safest_next_action: Escalate through the airline's grievance and nodal officer channels with the cancellation notice and replacement-ticket receipt.

complaint_text: My broadband has been down for 4 days but monthly bill is full ₹999. Engineer visited once and marked issue resolved without fixing anything. I have screenshots of the outage and ticket closure. Please restore service and adjust billing for outage days.
company_reply_email: Sir, aapki complaint note kar li gayi hai. Technical team ko dobara assign kiya hai. Hum aapko jaldi update karenge. Billing adjustment ka decision service restoration ke baad liya jayega. Kindly wait.
safest_next_action: Follow up on the complaint ticket and escalate to the Telecom Appellate Authority if the service and billing issue remain unresolved.

complaint_text: Cashless claim was denied for my father's hospitalisation. Hospital says all documents were submitted, but insurer rejected saying pre-existing condition without explaining which clause. Claim amount is ₹86,400. I need the exact policy clause and reconsideration.
company_reply_email: Dear policyholder, to reconsider your claim, please submit the discharge summary, complete medical history for the preceding 5 years, consultation records, diagnostic reports and any additional documents requested by the claims team. Your claim will be reviewed upon receipt of these documents.
safest_next_action: Submit the requested medical records and escalate the denial through the insurer's grievance process if the clause-based explanation remains inadequate.

complaint_text: UPI payment of ₹4,750 failed at merchant but money deducted from my account. Merchant confirms they didn't receive payment. Bank app says successful. It's been 6 days and no reversal. UPI transaction ID fake format? Actual ID is below.
company_reply_email: Dear customer, we have reviewed your dispute and the transaction was completed successfully as per our records. Since the payment was authenticated using your registered device and UPI PIN, we are unable to process a reversal. The merchant-side confirmation does not alter the status of the transaction in our system.
safest_next_action: Raise a formal UPI dispute with the bank and escalate through its nodal grievance channel if the failed merchant payment is not reversed.

complaint_text: Bought a study chair from your physical store in Jaipur. Staff promised free assembly but delivery team charged ₹350 extra and said it wasn't included. I have the bill and WhatsApp message from store staff. Please return the extra amount.
company_reply_email: Dear customer, we are sorry for the inconvenience. As a goodwill gesture, we can provide a ₹350 shopping voucher valid for 30 days at our store. Please confirm if you would like to accept this offer so we can arrange it.
safest_next_action: Decline the voucher if cash reimbursement is preferred and escalate with the bill and staff's written promise.

complaint_text: Booked a hotel through TripOrbit, but property refused check-in saying booking was never received. I called OTA support 4 times while standing at hotel. Had to book another property for ₹5,200. Original booking was ₹3,600. Please refund original amount and compensate for the additional expense.
company_reply_email: Hello, we understand that this experience was disappointing. Your booking and the associated complaint have been reviewed by our team. Based on the information currently available, we believe the matter has been handled in accordance with the booking conditions. However, if you have any further information that you feel may assist us in reconsidering the outcome, please reply to this email.
safest_next_action: Escalate to the OTA's Grievance Officer with the booking confirmation, hotel refusal evidence and replacement booking receipt.
